message.reasoning: Need HTS code for propane storage vessels. Likely 7308.90.90? Actually 7308 is "Other containers of iron or steel, of a capacity exceeding 2000 liters". For propane tanks maybe 7308.90.90. But 7308.90.90 is "Other containers of iron or steel, of a capacity exceeding 2000 liters, of a kind used for the storage of liquids". Propane is gas but stored as liquid. So 7308.90.90. Provide reason.
